name: May 28, 2024 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  MAY 28, 2024
  CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Lawrence called the meeting t0 order at 9:34 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Fireball Lawrence; Vice Chair Julia Holland; and Commissioners Lotte
  Cherin (arrived at 9:36 a.m.) and Peter Jones

  ABSENT: Commissioner Barry Haldeman and Ex-Offlcio Graeme Clifford

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Vice Chair Holland moved, and Chair Lawrence seconded a motion to approve the
  agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Commissioners
  Haldeman and Cherin (arrived at 9:36 a.m.) absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the meeting agenda was properly posted on
  May 23, 2024.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  None.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that the 2024 Student Poetry
  and Art Anthology was distributed to students, and copies were provided to
  the Malibu Public Library, City Council, and Malibu Principals.

  In response to Commissioner Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated Council would review the Temporary Use Permit Ordinance in
  August.

  Commissioner Cherin arrived at 9:36 a.m.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Chair Lawrence stated that the Art Talks series, featuring Pep Williams,
  would be on June 4 at the Santa Monica College Malibu Satellite Campus.
  He stated the Call for Artists for the summer art exhibition would close on
  May 3 1.

  3.  Business and Community Outreach

  Chair Lawrence stated the Commission should work on the Malibu Nights
  event without depending on the partnership with the Malibu-Palisades
  Chamber of Commerce.

  Commissioner Jones stated he would meet with Commissioner Haldeman
  to discuss event planning for Malibu Nights.

  4.  Social Media

  Chair Lawrence stated that enhanced efforts were needed for social media
  outreach and interaction.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated the Department had planned to
  focus on producing videos, which have proven to reach more people.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Vice Chair Holland moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to
  approve the Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 4—
  0; Commissioner Haldeman absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1. Approval of Minutes
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of May 28, 2024
  Page 3 of 4

  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the April 23, 2024 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular Meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Pacific Coast Highway Art Memorial
  Recommended Action: l) Review the proposed Pacific Coast Highway art
  memorial project; and 2) Provide a recommendation regarding the proposed
  prOJect.

  Caroline Jones stated that she founded DigitalandstoneTM and discussed her
  proposal of creating a memorial art piece. She stated she planned to discuss the
  project with Pepperdine University and wanted support from the City. She stated
  she would seek project funding through private fundraising efforts, the City, and
  Pepperdine University.

  In response to Commissioner Cherin, Ms. Jones stated that Digitalandstonem was
  not a nonprofit organization.

  Vice Chair Holland stated the memorial was a great idea.

  Chair Lawrence stated the project would be multilayered, with several
  opportunities to gain support and raise funds from the community and businesses.
  He stated the proposed location on Webb Way and Pacific Coast Highway could
  be supported but suggested reviewing different locations in Malibu or Legacy Park.

  Commissioner Jones stated there had been issues installing sculptures in the City
  and suggested that the artist leam what was allowed. He suggested incorporating
  water into the memorial sculpture.

  Commissioner Cherin suggested the artist attend and present her pr0posal to the
  Parks and Recreation and Public Safety Commissions.

  Chair Lawrence indicated agreement with Commissioner Cherin.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated the Planning Department would
  provide information on zoning and restrictions regarding the installation of a
  sculpture.

MOTION  Chair Lawrence moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to support
  the project concept. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0;
  Commissioner Haldeman absent.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on Community Lands
  Outreach meetings and poetry programs.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Vice Chair Holland stated she attended a free community dance event in Santa
  Barbara. She inquired if the City could host free dance workshops at a park.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Marketing
  Dance Workshops

ADJOURNMENT

  At 11:03 a.m., Chair Lawrence adjourned the meeting.

  Approved and adopted by the Malibu Arts
  Commission of the City of Malibu on June 25,
  2024.

  ALL LAWRENCE, Chair

ATTEST:

  LEAUMUA, Administrative Assistant
